rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Vegetation is the natural plant cover of a region, determined by climate, altitude, soil, and human activity. Nepal's vegetation is zoned by altitude: Terai (sal, grasslands), sub-montane, temperate (oak, rhododendron), sub-alpine (pine, fir), alpine (meadows, lichens), and nival (bare rock).…

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Vegetation is the NATURAL plant cover; plantations and cultivated crops are human-made, not natural vegetation.  ·  In-situ conservation protects vegetation IN its natural habitat; ex-situ conserves plant material OUTSIDE.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: NEB expects the definition of vegetation and its determinants (climate, altitude, soil, human activity).  ·  List Nepal's vegetation types by altitude.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Vegetation types: Terai (sal, grasslands), temperate (oak, rhododendron), sub-alpine (pine, fir), alpine (meadows, lichens), nival (bare rock).  ·  In-situ: Chitwan, Sagarmatha, Annapurna national parks; community forests; sacred groves.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: Vegetation introduction: the natural plant cover of a region; determined by climate, altitude, soil, and human activity.  ·  Types of vegetation in Nepal: Terai subtropical (sal, grasslands), sub-montane (mixed deciduous), temperate (oak, rhododendron, chestnut), sub-alpine (pine, fir, juniper), alpine (meadows, dwarf shrubs, lichens), nival (bare rock, snow).  ·  In-situ conservation: protecting vegetation in its natural location — protected areas, community forests, sacred groves.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Community forestry  ·  Natural vegetation conservation refers to the preservation and protection of indigenous plant species, ecosystems, and habitats in their natural state.  ·  It involves efforts to maintain the diversity, health, and balance of plant communities and their associated fauna, often through the implementation of various strategies such as protected area designation, habitat restoration, sustainable land management practices, and biodiversity conservation initiatives.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: The goal of natural vegetation conservation is to safeguard ecosystems from degradation, habitat loss, and extinction, ensuring their long-term survival and ecological function for future generations.  ·  In-situ conservation: This strategy focuses on the protection of rare, endangered, and threatened species of plants and animals in their own natural habitat.  ·  For example, national parks and other protected areas.
